info.name: JobLoom — Job Mass Assignment Proof
info.description:
Automated proof of Job mass assignment on CREATE, plus a check that UPDATE rejects ownership fields.

## Current app behaviour (important)
- **CREATE (`POST /jobs`)** still spreads the full body into the Job model → internal fields like `applicantsCount` / `status` can be set by the client. **Folder 03 is the main proof.**
- **UPDATE (`PUT /jobs/:id`)** already rejects unexpected fields (`checkExact` → "Unexpected field(s) in job update") and only assigns an allow-list. Injecting `employerId` returns **400**. **Folder 04 documents that block** (tests should pass when secure).

## How to read results
| Folder | Green tests mean |
| --- | --- |
| 01–02 | Setup / baseline OK |
| **03** | **MASS ASSIGNMENT CONFIRMED on CREATE** |
| **04** | UPDATE correctly **blocks** `employerId` (not vulnerable on this path) |

## Prerequisites
1. Backend at `http://localhost:3000`
2. `npm run seed:basic` in `JobLoom-BE-SSD-main`
3. Re-import this collection if you still have an older copy

## How to run
Collection Runner → keep order 01→05 → Run.

## Variables
| Variable | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:3000/api` |
| `employerEmail` | `seed.employer.basic@jobloom.test` |
| `employerPassword` | `Test@1234` |
| `seekerEmail` | `seed.seeker.basic@jobloom.test` |
| `seekerPassword` | `Test@1234` |
| `token` / `myEmployerId` / `otherUserId` / `jobId` / `ownershipJobId` | auto-filled |

item.name: 01 Setup
item.description: Authenticate and capture IDs. Run these first. No mass-assignment checks yet.

request.description:

- Status **200**
- Body contains `token` and `_id`

## Automated side effects
- Saves `token` → used as Bearer auth for later requests
- Saves `myEmployerId` → your employer user id

## If it fails
Run `npm run seed:basic` in `JobLoom-BE-SSD-main`, or update `employerEmail` / `employerPassword`.

request.description:
## Input (normal fields + injected internals)
Same as baseline, plus:
```json
"applicantsCount": 4242,
"status": "filled",
"isActive": true
```

These are real Job schema fields. `createJobValidation` does not allow-list them, but the service spreads the full body into `new Job({ ...jobData, employerId })`.

## Expected if VULNERABLE
| Check | Value |
| --- | --- |
| HTTP | **201** |
| `data.applicantsCount` | **4242** |
| `data.status` | **"filled"** |

Postman tests named **MASS ASSIGNMENT CONFIRMED** will **pass** when vulnerable.

## Expected if SECURE
| Outcome | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 201 with `applicantsCount: 0` and `status: "open"` | extras ignored |
| **or** 400 rejecting forbidden fields | properly rejected |

In that case the **MASS ASSIGNMENT CONFIRMED** tests **fail** (good).
